posts.title: Decision Fatigue and Decision Making Wisdom
posts.description: A synthesis of decision fatigue and decision-making wisdom from various sources. Overview Decision fatigue is the deteriorating quality of decisions made after a long session of decision making. The more choices we make throughout the day, the harder each subsequent choice becomes.
